# REAL METRES, Unity axes (+x starboard, +y up, +z nose), flight-line frame,
# origin on the ground under the middle of the main axle.
scale 2.800 5.000
# pivot part x y z  ax ay az   (AngleAxis(angle, axis) about the pivot)
pivot prop -0.00000 1.95000 2.90000 0.00000 -0.00000 -1.00000
pivot aileron_l -4.85000 3.57312 -0.96200 0.99905 -0.04362 -0.00000
pivot aileron_r 4.85000 3.57312 -0.96200 0.99905 0.04362 -0.00000
pivot elevator -0.00000 2.62000 -8.64550 1.00000 -0.00000 -0.00000
pivot rudder -0.00000 2.40000 -8.76000 0.00000 1.00000 -0.00000
# contact wheel x y z   bottom of each tyre
contact l -1.72500 -0.00000 0.00000
contact r 1.72500 -0.00000 0.00000
contact tail -0.00000 1.19000 -8.25000
parked 8.2079
# seat index x y z   feet of the man; -1 is the pilot (port seat)
seat -1 -0.4200 1.3800 0.1317

# box name cx cy cz sx sy sz   hull colliders
